attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard in order to use this attack.

power.name: Energy Burn
power.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into {Fire} Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
